findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 420 requests to 103 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

65 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising).
173 cookies were set by third-party domains (217 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.
